examples.en: Before modern telecommunications, governments relied on messengers to carry important information between distant towns and military posts.
examples.zh: 在现代电信出现之前，政府依靠信使在相距遥远的城镇和军事哨所之间传递重要信息。

collocations: act as a messenger｜充当传话人

senses.en: someone who prepares written material or manages a publication
someone who selects and arranges recorded images or sound
software used to change digital content

examples.en: The editor suggested a clearer ending for my story.
examples.zh: 编辑建议我给故事写一个更清楚的结尾。

examples.en: A newspaper editor must balance the public's right to information with respect for individual privacy.
examples.zh: 报纸编辑必须在公众知情权与尊重个人隐私之间取得平衡。

collocations: editor of a magazine｜杂志编辑

senses.en: A person who types, especially as a job.

examples.en: The typist finished the letter before her lunch break.
examples.zh: 打字员在午休前打完了那封信。

examples.en: Although dedicated typist positions are less common today, accurate keyboard skills remain valuable in many workplaces.
examples.zh: 虽然如今专职打字员岗位较少，但准确的键盘输入技能在许多工作场所仍然很有价值。

collocations: a skilled typist｜熟练的打字员

senses.en: A document given to people attending a lesson or meeting.
Money or goods given free to someone in need.

examples.en: Our teacher gave us a handout about healthy eating.
examples.zh: 老师给我们发了一份关于健康饮食的讲义。

examples.en: A well-designed handout can help students review key concepts independently after a lecture has finished.
examples.zh: 一份设计得当的讲义可以帮助学生在讲座结束后独立复习核心概念。

senses.en: A small printed sheet giving information or advertising something.

examples.en: A volunteer handed me a leaflet about the new library.
examples.zh: 一位志愿者递给我一张介绍新图书馆的传单。

examples.en: Health centres can distribute a leaflet explaining how regular exercise helps prevent several common diseases.
examples.zh: 医疗中心可以发放宣传单，解释规律运动如何帮助预防几种常见疾病。

senses.en: to produce books or other writing for public reading
to make information officially available to the public

examples.en: The local magazine published my photograph of the river.
examples.zh: 当地杂志刊登了我拍摄的河流照片。

examples.en: Researchers should publish their findings openly so that policymakers can make decisions based on reliable evidence.
examples.zh: 研究人员应公开发表研究结果，让政策制定者能够依据可靠证据作出决策。

senses.en: to know or expect something before it happens

examples.en: We didn't foresee such a long queue outside.
examples.zh: 我们没料到外面会排这么长的队。

examples.en: Urban planners must foresee future transport needs before approving major housing developments on the city's outskirts.
examples.zh: 城市规划者在批准城郊的大型住宅开发项目之前，必须预见未来的交通需求。

senses.en: to believe that something will probably happen
to regard something as necessary or reasonably required
to believe someone or something will arrive soon

examples.en: We expect rain, so take an umbrella with you.
examples.zh: 我们预计会下雨，所以带上雨伞吧。

examples.en: Employers increasingly expect graduates to demonstrate practical skills as well as a strong understanding of their subject.
examples.zh: 雇主越来越期望毕业生既展现实践技能，又具备扎实的专业知识。

collocations: expect to do something｜预计做某事
expect someone to do something｜期望某人做某事

senses.en: To wait for someone or something
To be ready or likely to happen to someone

examples.en: We eagerly await the arrival of our new puppy.
examples.zh: 我们热切地等待着新来的小狗到家。

examples.en: Many graduates await job offers while developing additional skills through voluntary work and online courses.
examples.zh: 许多毕业生在等待录用通知期间，通过志愿工作和在线课程学习更多技能。

senses.en: An activity you enjoy doing in your free time.

examples.en: Gardening became her favourite pastime after she retired.
examples.zh: 退休后，园艺成了她最喜欢的消遣。

examples.en: Outdoor pastimes can improve mental health while encouraging people to spend less time using electronic devices.
examples.zh: 户外休闲活动可以改善心理健康，同时鼓励人们减少使用电子设备的时间。

senses.en: to keep someone interested or amused
to welcome guests and provide food, drink, or activities
to consider an idea or hold a thought or feeling

examples.en: My brother entertained the children with funny animal noises.
examples.zh: 我哥哥模仿动物发出滑稽的叫声，逗孩子们开心。

examples.en: Public museums should educate visitors as well as entertain them through engaging displays and interactive activities.
examples.zh: 公共博物馆应通过引人入胜的展览和互动活动，让参观者既获得知识又享受乐趣。

collocations: entertain an audience｜为观众提供娱乐
entertain the idea of｜考虑……的想法

senses.en: Activities done for enjoyment and relaxation when not working.

examples.en: I swim for recreation at the local leisure centre.
examples.zh: 我在当地休闲中心游泳消遣。

examples.en: Access to green spaces encourages outdoor recreation and can improve both physical health and mental wellbeing.
examples.zh: 能够方便地使用绿地有助于鼓励户外休闲活动，并可改善身心健康。

senses.en: To make someone smile or laugh.
To keep someone pleasantly occupied.

examples.en: His silly dance amused everyone waiting in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 他滑稽的舞蹈逗乐了在厨房等候的每个人。

examples.en: Interactive museum exhibits can amuse young visitors while helping them understand complex scientific ideas.
examples.zh: 博物馆的互动展品既能让小游客玩得开心，也能帮助他们理解复杂的科学概念。

collocations: keep someone amused｜让某人不无聊

senses.en: General agreement among members of a group.

examples.en: We finally reached a consensus on where to eat.
examples.zh: 我们终于就去哪里吃饭达成了共识。

examples.en: There is a broad consensus among researchers that early childhood education can improve children's future learning outcomes.
examples.zh: 研究人员普遍认为，幼儿教育能改善儿童未来的学习成效。

senses.en: A special occasion when people celebrate a tradition or event
An organised series of performances or other cultural events

examples.en: Our town holds a lantern festival every autumn.
examples.zh: 我们镇每年秋天都会举办灯会。

examples.en: An annual arts festival can attract visitors while providing local performers with valuable opportunities to reach wider audiences.
examples.zh: 一年一度的艺术节既能吸引游客，也能为当地表演者提供接触更多观众的宝贵机会。

collocations: hold a festival｜举办节庆活动

senses.en: A large, special meal with plenty of food.
Something that gives great pleasure to the senses.
To eat and enjoy a large amount of food.

examples.en: We prepared a feast for the whole family.
examples.zh: 我们为全家准备了一顿盛宴。

examples.en: Traditional festivals often include a communal feast that strengthens relationships and preserves local food culture.
examples.zh: 传统节日常有集体宴席，既增进人际关系，也传承当地饮食文化。

collocations: a feast for the eyes｜视觉盛宴

senses.en: an organised set of activities with a particular purpose
a show broadcast on television or radio
to arrange activities or set a machine to operate automatically

examples.en: I joined a fitness programme at the local gym.
examples.zh: 我参加了当地健身房的一项健身计划。

examples.en: A well-designed training programme can help unemployed adults gain the skills needed for new careers.
examples.zh: 设计合理的培训项目能帮助失业成年人掌握新职业所需的技能。

collocations: launch a programme｜启动一项计划

senses.en: A practice session before a performance or important event.

examples.en: Our final rehearsal finished just before the audience arrived.
examples.zh: 我们的最后一次排练在观众到来前刚刚结束。

examples.en: Regular rehearsal helps students develop confidence and teamwork skills before they perform in front of an audience.
examples.zh: 定期排练有助于学生在登台表演前培养信心和团队合作能力。

senses.en: to entertain an audience by acting, singing, or playing music
to carry out a task, action, or duty
to work or achieve results in a particular way

examples.en: Our choir will perform at the community centre tonight.
examples.zh: 我们的合唱团今晚将在社区中心演出。

examples.en: Students often perform better academically when schools provide regular feedback and access to individual support.
examples.zh: 学校提供定期反馈和个别支持时，学生的学业表现往往更好。

senses.en: To copy someone's actions, speech, or way of doing something
To make something look or behave like something else

examples.en: Our little sister loves to imitate animal sounds.
examples.zh: 我们的小妹妹喜欢模仿动物的叫声。

examples.en: Young children often imitate adult behaviour, so parents play an important role in developing healthy habits.
examples.zh: 幼儿经常模仿成年人的行为，因此父母在培养健康习惯方面发挥着重要作用。

senses.en: to copy someone's behaviour or reproduce something's features
a person skilled at copying other people's voices or behaviour

examples.en: Our parrot mimics the sound of the doorbell perfectly.
examples.zh: 我们家的鹦鹉把门铃声模仿得惟妙惟肖。

examples.en: Engineers increasingly mimic natural structures to develop lighter materials that require less energy to manufacture.
examples.zh: 工程师越来越多地模拟自然结构，以开发制造时耗能更低的轻质材料。

collocations: mimic someone's voice｜模仿某人的声音
mimic natural processes｜模拟自然过程
a talented mimic｜有天赋的模仿者

senses.en: To reproduce conditions or processes for testing, training, or study.
To pretend to have a feeling or condition.

examples.en: This driving game simulates icy roads surprisingly well.
examples.zh: 这款驾驶游戏把结冰路面模拟得出奇逼真。

examples.en: Researchers simulate extreme weather conditions to assess how new building materials perform under environmental stress.
examples.zh: 研究人员模拟极端天气条件，以评估新型建筑材料在环境压力下的表现。

collocations: simulate an emergency｜模拟紧急情况
simulate the effects of｜模拟……的影响

senses.en: A group or show featuring acrobats, clowns, and other performers.

examples.en: We watched the circus performers juggle brightly coloured balls.
examples.zh: 我们看着马戏演员抛接色彩鲜艳的球。

examples.en: Modern circus performances can preserve traditional entertainment skills while creating opportunities for artists from diverse backgrounds.
examples.zh: 现代马戏表演既能保留传统娱乐技艺，也能为不同背景的艺术工作者创造机会。

senses.en: An imaginary supernatural power, or tricks that seem to use it.
A special quality that makes something exciting or wonderful.
Having supernatural powers or used in performing tricks.

examples.en: The children laughed when he performed a magic trick.
examples.zh: 他表演魔术时，孩子们笑了起来。

examples.en: Although technology can improve education, it is not a magic solution to every problem schools face.
examples.zh: 虽然技术能够改善教育，但它不是解决学校所有问题的神奇办法。

senses.en: Plays and the art of writing or performing them.
An exciting or emotional event or situation.

examples.en: Our drama group rehearses in the hall every Thursday.
examples.zh: 我们的戏剧小组每周四在大厅排练。

examples.en: Teaching drama in schools can develop students' confidence and encourage them to consider different perspectives.
examples.zh: 在学校教授戏剧可以培养学生的自信，并鼓励他们从不同角度思考。

senses.en: a live musical performance given before an audience

examples.en: We enjoyed an outdoor concert in the park yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我们在公园欣赏了一场露天音乐会。

examples.en: Free public concerts can make cultural activities more accessible and encourage residents to use shared urban spaces.
examples.zh: 免费公共音乐会能让更多人参与文化活动，并鼓励居民使用城市公共空间。

senses.en: a long orchestral composition, usually divided into several movements

examples.en: We listened to a symphony while cooking dinner.
examples.zh: 我们做晚饭时听了一首交响曲。

examples.en: Performing a symphony requires close cooperation among musicians, demonstrating the importance of teamwork in the arts.
examples.zh: 演奏交响曲需要音乐家之间密切合作，体现了团队协作在艺术中的重要性。

senses.en: A large group of musicians playing different instruments together.

examples.en: The orchestra began playing as the lights dimmed.
examples.zh: 灯光暗下来时，管弦乐队开始演奏。

examples.en: Public funding helps the local orchestra offer affordable concerts and introduce classical music to younger audiences.
examples.zh: 公共资助帮助当地管弦乐队举办票价亲民的音乐会，并向年轻观众介绍古典音乐。

collocations: conduct an orchestra｜指挥管弦乐队
play in an orchestra｜在管弦乐队演奏

senses.en: A formal dance style, or a performance using this style.

examples.en: My sister practises ballet at the studio every Saturday.
examples.zh: 我姐姐每周六都在舞蹈室练习芭蕾舞。

examples.en: Public funding for ballet can help preserve artistic traditions and make performances accessible to a wider audience.
examples.zh: 为芭蕾舞提供公共资金有助于保护艺术传统，并让更多观众有机会观看演出。

senses.en: a musical drama in which performers sing most words

examples.en: We watched an opera at the theatre last night.
examples.zh: 我们昨晚在剧院看了一部歌剧。

examples.en: Public funding for opera can preserve artistic traditions while making performances accessible to a wider audience.
examples.zh: 为歌剧提供公共资助既能保护艺术传统，也能让更多观众有机会欣赏演出。

senses.en: Entertainment intended to make people laugh.
The humorous quality of a situation or event.

examples.en: We watched a comedy and laughed all evening.
examples.zh: 我们看了一部喜剧，整个晚上都笑个不停。

examples.en: Comedy can encourage audiences to question social attitudes by presenting familiar problems in unexpected and amusing ways.
examples.zh: 喜剧可以用出人意料又有趣的方式呈现常见问题，促使观众反思社会观念。

senses.en: An event causing great suffering, sadness, or loss.
A serious play or story ending in suffering or death.

examples.en: The whole village came together after the tragedy.
examples.zh: 惨剧发生后，全村人团结起来了。

examples.en: Improved road design and stricter safety regulations can help prevent the tragedy of avoidable traffic deaths.
examples.zh: 改进道路设计并加强安全规定，有助于防止本可避免的交通死亡悲剧。

senses.en: a story or events recorded as moving pictures
to record moving pictures using a camera
a thin layer, or material used to record photographs

examples.en: We watched a funny film after dinner yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天晚饭后，我们看了一部有趣的电影。

examples.en: Documentary films can raise public awareness of environmental problems by showing their effects on local communities.
examples.zh: 纪录片可以通过展示环境问题对当地社区的影响，提高公众的环保意识。

collocations: a thin film of oil｜一层薄薄的油膜

senses.en: a recorded story or sequence of moving images for watching

examples.en: We watched a funny movie after dinner last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚晚饭后，我们看了一部有趣的电影。

examples.en: Movies can introduce audiences to unfamiliar cultures, although they sometimes reinforce stereotypes rather than challenge them.
examples.zh: 电影可以向观众介绍陌生文化，不过有时也会强化刻板印象，而非打破它们。

collocations: go to the movies｜去看电影

senses.en: a person who creates paintings, sculptures, or other art
a person who performs music or other entertainment professionally

examples.en: The artist painted the harbour in soft blue colours.
examples.zh: 这位画家用柔和的蓝色描绘了港口。

examples.en: Public funding allows an artist to create work that enriches community life without depending entirely on sales.
examples.zh: 公共资助使艺术家能够创作丰富社区生活的作品，而不必完全依赖销售收入。

senses.en: A skilled person, especially a man, who makes things by hand.

examples.en: The craftsman carved a wooden bird for the display.
examples.zh: 那位工匠雕了一只木鸟用于展示。

examples.en: Supporting local craftsmen can preserve traditional skills while providing communities with sustainable sources of income.
examples.zh: 支持当地手艺人既能保护传统技艺，也能为社区提供可持续的收入来源。

collocations: a skilled craftsman｜技艺娴熟的工匠

senses.en: Someone who creates pictures using paint.
Someone whose job is painting buildings or other surfaces.

examples.en: The painter mixed blue and green on her palette.
examples.zh: 画家在调色板上混合蓝色和绿色。

examples.en: Local painters can preserve cultural traditions while introducing younger audiences to new artistic styles.
examples.zh: 当地画家既能传承文化传统，也能让年轻观众接触新的艺术风格。

senses.en: The function or responsibility someone or something has.
A character played by an actor in a performance.

examples.en: My role is to welcome guests at the door.
examples.zh: 我的职责是在门口迎接客人。

examples.en: Public libraries play an important role in providing equal access to information and educational resources.
examples.zh: 公共图书馆在提供平等获取信息和教育资源的机会方面发挥着重要作用。

collocations: play a role in｜在……中起作用
take on a role｜承担职责

senses.en: a view or situation that you see
the place where an event happens
a short part of a play or film

examples.en: The children playing by the lake made a peaceful scene.
examples.zh: 孩子们在湖边玩耍，构成了一幅宁静的画面。

examples.en: The film's opening scene highlights the challenges faced by families living in crowded urban neighbourhoods.
examples.zh: 影片的开场片段突出了居住在拥挤城市社区的家庭面临的挑战。

senses.en: A particular period or step in a process.
A raised area where performers appear before an audience.
To organise and present a performance or public event.

examples.en: The cake is cooling at this stage of preparation.
examples.zh: 制作进行到这个阶段，蛋糕正在冷却。

examples.en: Early intervention at a critical stage of childhood can significantly improve educational outcomes later in life.
examples.zh: 在童年的关键阶段及早干预，能显著改善日后的教育成果。

collocations: at an early stage｜在早期阶段
a stage of development｜发展阶段

senses.en: A room or building where artworks are displayed or sold.
A raised seating area overlooking a hall or theatre.
A collection of images available to view, especially online.

examples.en: We spent a rainy afternoon exploring the local gallery.
examples.zh: 一个下雨的下午，我们逛了当地的美术馆。

examples.en: Free entry to a public gallery can make visual art accessible to people from different economic backgrounds.
examples.zh: 公共美术馆免费开放，可以让不同经济背景的人都有机会接触视觉艺术。

collocations: public gallery｜公共美术馆；旁听席

senses.en: A public display of art, objects, or products.

examples.en: We visited a photography exhibition at the local museum.
examples.zh: 我们参观了当地博物馆的一场摄影展。

examples.en: An interactive exhibition can make scientific discoveries more accessible to children and encourage their interest in research.
examples.zh: 互动展览能让儿童更容易理解科学发现，并激发他们对研究的兴趣。

senses.en: Relating to beauty or the appreciation of beautiful things.
A particular style or set of ideas about beauty.

examples.en: The wooden shelves give this room greater aesthetic appeal.
examples.zh: 这些木架让这个房间更有美感。

examples.en: Urban planners should consider both the practical function and aesthetic quality of public spaces.
examples.zh: 城市规划者应同时考虑公共空间的实用功能和审美品质。

senses.en: To gather things together or keep objects as a hobby
To go somewhere and bring someone or something away
To receive or gather money from people

examples.en: I collect smooth stones whenever we visit the beach.
examples.zh: 每次去海边，我都会收集光滑的石头。

examples.en: Researchers collect data from local households to assess how transport policies affect daily travel habits.
examples.zh: 研究人员收集当地家庭的数据，以评估交通政策如何影响日常出行习惯。

senses.en: Choose someone or something carefully from available options.
Carefully chosen for special quality or suitability.

examples.en: Please select a fresh apple from the basket.
examples.zh: 请从篮子里挑选一个新鲜的苹果。

examples.en: Universities should select applicants using a range of criteria rather than relying entirely on examination results.
examples.zh: 大学应依据多种标准选拔申请者，而非完全依赖考试成绩。

collocations: select from a list｜从列表中选择
select someone for a role｜选某人担任角色
a select group｜精选的一群人

senses.en: a picture made using a camera
to take a picture of someone or something using a camera

examples.en: This photograph shows my grandparents standing beside their first house.
examples.zh: 这张照片里，我的祖父母站在他们的第一所房子旁。

examples.en: Historical photographs provide valuable evidence of how urban landscapes and everyday lifestyles have changed over time.
examples.zh: 历史照片为城市景观和日常生活方式如何随时间变化提供了宝贵的证据。

senses.en: a painting, drawing, or photograph of a person
a detailed description of a person, place, or situation

examples.en: My grandmother's portrait hangs above the living room fireplace.
examples.zh: 我祖母的肖像挂在客厅壁炉上方。

examples.en: The documentary offers a compelling portrait of rural life as younger generations move to urban areas.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片生动描绘了年轻一代迁往城市背景下的乡村生活。

senses.en: A picture made using paint.
The activity of creating pictures with paint.
The activity of covering a surface with paint.

examples.en: We hung a colourful painting above the sofa.
examples.zh: 我们在沙发上方挂了一幅色彩鲜艳的画。

examples.en: Public galleries make important paintings accessible to everyone, regardless of their income or educational background.
examples.zh: 公共美术馆让所有人都能欣赏重要画作，不受收入或教育背景的限制。

senses.en: an artwork made by carving, shaping, or assembling materials
the art of creating solid forms from materials

examples.en: A bronze sculpture of a horse stands outside the library.
examples.zh: 图书馆外矗立着一座马的青铜雕塑。

examples.en: Public sculpture can strengthen a city's cultural identity while making art accessible to people outside traditional galleries.
examples.zh: 公共雕塑能增强城市的文化认同，同时让传统美术馆之外的人们也能接触艺术。

senses.en: Make a picture using a pencil, pen, or similar tool.
Move something by pulling it in a particular direction.
Attract people, interest, or attention to something.

examples.en: She drew a sleeping cat in her sketchbook.
examples.zh: 她在素描本上画了一只熟睡的猫。

examples.en: Free cultural events can draw more visitors to museums and encourage wider participation in the arts.
examples.zh: 免费文化活动可以吸引更多人参观博物馆，并鼓励公众更广泛地参与艺术活动。

senses.en: to show or describe something in art, images, or words

examples.en: This painting depicts children playing beside a quiet lake.
examples.zh: 这幅画描绘了孩子们在宁静的湖边玩耍的情景。

examples.en: Films often depict urban life as exciting, overlooking the isolation that many residents experience in large cities.
examples.zh: 电影常将城市生活描绘得令人兴奋，却忽略了许多大城市居民感受到的孤独。

collocations: depict daily life｜描绘日常生活
depict someone as｜将某人描绘成

senses.en: to explain what someone or something is like

examples.en: Can you describe the bag you left on the bus?
examples.zh: 你能描述一下你落在公交车上的包吗？

examples.en: The report describes how access to public parks influences physical activity among residents of crowded cities.
examples.zh: 该报告描述了公共公园的可达性如何影响人口密集城市居民的体育活动。

collocations: describe something in detail｜详细描述某事物
describe something as｜把某事物形容为
describe a process｜描述一个过程

senses.en: to shape wood or stone by cutting away material
to cut cooked meat into slices for serving

examples.en: My grandfather carved a little bird from soft wood.
examples.zh: 我祖父用软木雕了一只小鸟。

examples.en: Local artisans carve traditional patterns into wooden furniture, preserving cultural skills while creating products for modern homes.
examples.zh: 当地工匠在木制家具上雕刻传统图案，既保留文化技艺，也为现代家庭制作产品。

collocations: carve out a career｜开创事业

senses.en: Relating to music, or showing skill and interest in it.
A play or film whose story includes songs and dancing.
Having a pleasant sound resembling music.

examples.en: He keeps his musical instruments beside the sofa.
examples.zh: 他把乐器放在沙发旁边。

examples.en: Schools that offer musical training give children valuable opportunities to develop creativity and practise teamwork.
examples.zh: 提供音乐训练的学校为孩子们培养创造力和练习团队合作提供了宝贵机会。

senses.en: relating to formal Western music, such as symphonies and operas
relating to ancient Greece or Rome and their culture
based on established theories rather than newer approaches

examples.en: My sister listens to classical music while cooking.
examples.zh: 我姐姐做饭时听古典音乐。

examples.en: Studying classical architecture helps students understand how ancient design principles continue to influence modern public buildings.
examples.zh: 研究古典建筑有助于学生理解古代设计原则如何持续影响现代公共建筑。

senses.en: Music with strong rhythms and often freely invented melodies.

examples.en: We listened to jazz while cooking dinner together.
examples.zh: 我们一起做晚饭时听了爵士乐。

examples.en: Community jazz festivals can attract visitors while giving local musicians valuable opportunities to perform.
examples.zh: 社区爵士音乐节既能吸引游客，也能为当地音乐人提供宝贵的演出机会。

senses.en: The hard natural material forming much of Earth's surface.
Popular music with a strong beat, often featuring electric guitars.
Move gently backwards and forwards or from side to side.

examples.en: We sat on a flat rock beside the river.
examples.zh: 我们坐在河边一块平坦的岩石上。

examples.en: Studying ancient rock layers helps scientists understand how the Earth's climate has changed over time.
examples.zh: 研究古老的岩层有助于科学家了解地球气候随时间发生的变化。

senses.en: popular music with catchy tunes and usually simple structures
to burst or make a short, sharp sound
to go somewhere briefly or put something somewhere quickly

examples.en: My sister listens to pop while she cooks dinner.
examples.zh: 我姐姐做晚饭时会听流行音乐。

examples.en: Pop can introduce young listeners to other cultures, especially when artists combine different musical traditions.
examples.zh: 流行音乐可以让年轻听众了解其他文化，尤其是在艺人融合不同音乐传统时。

collocations: pop into a shop｜顺便进店

senses.en: A group of musicians who perform together.
A narrow strip or ring of material or colour.
A range of frequencies, values, or levels within a system.

examples.en: My sister plays the drums in a local band.
examples.zh: 我姐姐在当地一支乐队里打鼓。

examples.en: Live bands at community festivals can attract visitors and create opportunities for local businesses.
examples.zh: 社区节庆中的现场乐队演出能吸引游客，并为当地商家创造机会。

senses.en: A musical piece or passage performed by one person.
Done or performed by one person alone.
Alone, without other people helping or taking part.

examples.en: Everyone fell silent when she began her violin solo.
examples.zh: 她开始小提琴独奏时，所有人都安静了下来。

examples.en: Solo travel can encourage independence by requiring individuals to manage unfamiliar situations without relying on companions.
examples.zh: 独自旅行要求人们不依赖同伴处理陌生情况，因此有助于培养独立性。

senses.en: A sequence of musical sounds forming a recognisable tune.

examples.en: She hummed a gentle melody while watering the plants.
examples.zh: 她一边给植物浇水，一边轻声哼着曲子。

examples.en: A memorable melody can help children recall information, making music a useful tool in early education.
examples.zh: 容易记住的旋律能帮助儿童回忆信息，因此音乐是幼儿教育中的实用工具。

senses.en: a series of musical notes forming a recognizable pattern
to adjust an instrument so it produces the correct notes
to adjust a device to work or receive signals correctly

examples.en: My brother whistled a cheerful tune while washing dishes.
examples.zh: 哥哥洗碗时，用口哨吹着一段欢快的曲调。

examples.en: A memorable tune can help young learners retain new vocabulary and develop greater confidence in speaking.
examples.zh: 容易记住的曲调可以帮助低龄学习者记忆新词汇，并增强口语表达的信心。

senses.en: A large musical instrument played by pressing black and white keys.

examples.en: My sister practises the piano after dinner every evening.
examples.zh: 我姐姐每天晚饭后练钢琴。

examples.en: Learning to play the piano can help children develop concentration and express their emotions creatively.
examples.zh: 学习弹钢琴能帮助儿童培养专注力，并创造性地表达情感。

senses.en: A four-stringed instrument held under the chin and usually bowed.

examples.en: My sister practises the violin after dinner every evening.
examples.zh: 我姐姐每天晚饭后都练习小提琴。

examples.en: Learning the violin can help children develop concentration, although regular lessons may be expensive for some families.
examples.zh: 学习小提琴有助于儿童培养专注力，但定期上课对某些家庭来说可能费用较高。

collocations: a violin concerto｜小提琴协奏曲

senses.en: A stringed musical instrument played by plucking or strumming.

examples.en: My sister plays the guitar beside the window every evening.
examples.zh: 我姐姐每天晚上都在窗边弹吉他。

examples.en: Learning to play the guitar can help students develop patience, coordination, and confidence through regular practice.
examples.zh: 学习弹吉他能帮助学生通过规律练习培养耐心、协调能力和自信。

senses.en: A brass musical instrument with three valves and a bright sound.
To announce or praise something loudly and publicly.
To make a loud sound like an elephant's call.

examples.en: The musician lifted her trumpet and played a cheerful tune.
examples.zh: 那位乐手举起小号，吹奏了一支欢快的曲子。

examples.en: Learning the trumpet in a school orchestra can improve students' concentration and ability to cooperate with others.
examples.zh: 在学校管弦乐队学习小号可以提升学生的专注力及与他人合作的能力。

senses.en: a musical instrument played by hitting its stretched surface
a large cylindrical container for storing liquids or other materials
to play a drum or tap something repeatedly

examples.en: The little boy beat the drum with both hands.
examples.zh: 小男孩用双手敲鼓。

examples.en: Learning to play the drum can help children develop coordination and participate in group performances.
examples.zh: 学习打鼓能帮助儿童培养协调能力，并参与集体表演。

senses.en: A wind instrument held sideways and played by blowing across it.

examples.en: She practises the flute by her bedroom window every afternoon.
examples.zh: 她每天下午都在卧室窗边练习长笛。

examples.en: Learning to play the flute can develop concentration and encourage children to participate in musical ensembles.
examples.zh: 学习吹长笛可以培养专注力，并鼓励儿童参加合奏团体。

senses.en: The effort to succeed against others seeking the same goal.
An organised event in which people try to win.

examples.en: Our school is holding a painting competition next Friday.
examples.zh: 我们学校下周五要举办绘画比赛。

examples.en: Competition between businesses can lower prices, but effective regulation is needed to protect consumers from unfair practices.
examples.zh: 企业间的竞争可以降低价格，但仍需有效监管来保护消费者免受不公平商业行为的侵害。

senses.en: a competition involving several games between different players or teams

examples.en: Our school tennis tournament starts next Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 我们学校的网球锦标赛下周六早上开始。

examples.en: Hosting an international tournament can boost tourism, but maintaining sports facilities afterwards may prove expensive.
examples.zh: 举办国际锦标赛能够促进旅游业，但赛后维护体育设施可能费用高昂。

senses.en: A person or organisation providing support, often in return for publicity.
To support a person, event, or activity financially.

examples.en: Our swimming club needs a sponsor for new equipment.
examples.zh: 我们的游泳俱乐部需要赞助者资助购置新器材。

examples.en: Local businesses can sponsor community sports programmes to improve public health and strengthen relationships with residents.
examples.zh: 当地企业可以赞助社区体育项目，以改善公众健康并加强与居民的联系。

senses.en: Someone who supports an artist, organisation, or activity, often financially.
A customer of a restaurant, theatre, or similar place.

examples.en: A local patron paid for the young artist's materials.
examples.zh: 一位当地赞助人出钱为这位年轻艺术家购买了材料。

examples.en: Private patrons can fund experimental art that might otherwise struggle to attract public financial support.
examples.zh: 私人赞助人能够资助那些可能难以获得公共资金支持的实验艺术。

collocations: patron of the arts｜艺术赞助人

senses.en: A person trained to compete in sports requiring physical skill.

examples.en: The athlete stretched her legs before the morning race.
examples.zh: 那位运动员在早上的比赛前伸展了双腿。

examples.en: Young athletes need balanced training programmes that protect their health while allowing them to pursue sporting excellence.
examples.zh: 年轻运动员需要均衡的训练计划，在追求卓越运动表现的同时保护健康。

collocations: a promising young athlete｜有潜力的年轻运动员

senses.en: a person or team that wins a competition
someone who strongly supports a cause or group
to actively support or defend a cause or person

examples.en: The new champion lifted her trophy with both hands.
examples.zh: 新冠军双手举起了奖杯。

examples.en: Local organisations can champion affordable housing by working with residents and presenting practical proposals to councils.
examples.zh: 地方组织可以与居民合作，向地方议会提交切实可行的提案，推动提供可负担住房。

collocations: a champion of equality｜平等的拥护者
champion a cause｜支持一项事业

senses.en: Someone who watches an event, especially a sporting event.

examples.en: A spectator caught the ball near the fence.
examples.zh: 一名观众在围栏附近接住了球。

examples.en: Major sporting events attract thousands of spectators and can generate substantial income for local businesses.
examples.zh: 大型体育赛事吸引成千上万的观众，并能为当地商家带来可观收入。

senses.en: someone who freely offers to help, usually without payment
to freely offer to do something or give information

examples.en: A volunteer helped us carry the boxes upstairs.
examples.zh: 一位志愿者帮我们把箱子搬上了楼。

examples.en: Universities can encourage students to volunteer in their communities by offering flexible schedules and practical support.
examples.zh: 大学可以通过提供灵活的时间安排和实际支持，鼓励学生参与社区志愿服务。

collocations: volunteer to help｜主动提出帮忙
volunteer for a charity｜为慈善机构做义工

senses.en: Known by many people.

examples.en: This village is famous for its delicious apple pies.
examples.zh: 这个村庄以美味的苹果派闻名。

examples.en: Famous landmarks attract international visitors, but tourism revenue should also support the communities surrounding them.
examples.zh: 著名地标吸引着国际游客，但旅游收入也应惠及周边社区。

senses.en: known or recognised by many people

examples.en: We visited a well-known castle during our summer holiday.
examples.zh: 暑假期间，我们参观了一座著名的城堡。

examples.en: Well-known tourist destinations often face overcrowding, which can damage historic sites and reduce residents' quality of life.
examples.zh: 著名旅游目的地常面临过度拥挤的问题，这可能损坏历史遗迹并降低居民的生活质量。

senses.zh: 精力充沛的；充满活力的
senses.en: Having or showing plenty of energy and enthusiasm.

examples.en: Our energetic puppy chased a ball around the garden.
examples.zh: 我们那只精力旺盛的小狗在花园里追着球跑。

examples.en: Regular physical activity can help office workers feel more energetic and maintain concentration throughout the day.
examples.zh: 经常运动有助于办公室职员更有活力，并在一天中保持专注。

senses.en: a large sports venue with seating around a central area

examples.en: Fans filled the stadium before the football match began.
examples.zh: 足球比赛开始前，球迷们就坐满了体育场。

examples.en: Building a new stadium may attract visitors, but its long-term maintenance costs require careful consideration.
examples.zh: 修建新体育场或许能吸引游客，但其长期维护费用需要仔细考虑。

collocations: packed stadium｜座无虚席的体育场

senses.en: A room or building equipped for exercise and sport.
Physical exercise taught or practised at school.

examples.en: I usually go to the gym before work.
examples.zh: 我通常在上班前去健身房。

examples.en: Affordable gym membership can encourage regular exercise, although safe outdoor spaces are equally important for public health.
examples.zh: 价格实惠的健身房会员服务能鼓励定期锻炼，不过安全的户外空间对公共健康同样重要。

collocations: go to the gym｜去健身房

senses.en: Learning and practice that develop skills for a particular activity.
Physical exercise and practice to prepare for sport.

examples.en: My first day of training involved helping customers.
examples.zh: 培训第一天，我就参与了为顾客提供帮助的工作。

examples.en: Regular professional training helps employees adapt to technological changes and improves their long-term career prospects.
examples.zh: 定期职业培训有助于员工适应技术变化，并改善他们的长期职业前景。

senses.en: Physical activity for health, or a task for practising skills.
To do physical activity to stay healthy or become stronger.
To use a right, power, ability, or quality.

examples.en: I get some exercise by walking to the shops.
examples.zh: 我步行去商店，顺便锻炼一下。

examples.en: Regular exercise can improve mental health and reduce the risk of several common chronic diseases.
examples.zh: 经常运动能够改善心理健康，并降低几种常见慢性病的患病风险。

senses.en: Located, used, or happening inside a building.

examples.en: Our hotel has an indoor pool beside the gym.
examples.zh: 我们酒店的健身房旁边有一个室内游泳池。

examples.en: Indoor sports facilities allow children to remain physically active regardless of weather conditions throughout the year.
examples.zh: 室内运动设施让孩子们全年都能保持运动，不受天气条件影响。

collocations: indoor air quality｜室内空气质量

senses.en: happening, used, or located outside a building

examples.en: We bought comfortable chairs for our outdoor dining area.
examples.zh: 我们给户外用餐区买了舒适的椅子。

examples.en: Regular outdoor activities can improve children's physical health while helping them develop an appreciation of nature.
examples.zh: 定期开展户外活动可以改善儿童的身体健康，同时培养他们对自然的欣赏。

senses.en: able to move or be moved easily between places
relating to phones or services used while away from home
a telephone you can carry and use almost anywhere

examples.en: The mobile library visits our village every Friday morning.
examples.zh: 流动图书馆每周五早晨来我们村。

examples.en: Mobile clinics can improve access to basic healthcare for people living in remote rural communities.
examples.zh: 流动诊所可以让偏远农村社区的居民更容易获得基本医疗服务。

senses.en: an act of changing position or moving the body
an organised effort by people seeking shared social change
one main section of a long piece of music

examples.en: A sudden movement in the bushes caught my attention.
examples.zh: 灌木丛里突然有动静，引起了我的注意。

examples.en: The environmental movement has encouraged governments to adopt stronger policies on waste reduction and renewable energy.
examples.zh: 环保运动推动各国政府在减少废物和发展可再生能源方面采取更有力的政策。

senses.en: A practice combining body positions, controlled breathing, and mental focus.

examples.en: She does yoga on a mat beside the window.
examples.zh: 她在窗边的垫子上练瑜伽。

examples.en: Offering yoga classes in community centres may help residents manage stress and maintain flexibility.
examples.zh: 在社区中心开设瑜伽课可能有助于居民缓解压力并保持身体柔韧。

senses.en: Sit or lie with your arms and legs spread out.
Spread over a large area in an unplanned way.
A large area of buildings spreading out without clear planning.

examples.en: After the hike, we sprawled on the soft grass.
examples.zh: 徒步结束后，我们四肢舒展地躺在柔软的草地上。

examples.en: Urban sprawl can increase dependence on private cars and put pressure on surrounding farmland.
examples.zh: 城市无序扩张会增加对私家车的依赖，并给周边农田带来压力。

collocations: sprawl on the sofa｜摊躺在沙发上
a sprawling city｜向外蔓延的城市

senses.en: pressure or difficulty that tests someone's strength or resources
to injure or overwork a muscle or body part
a particular type of plant, animal, or microorganism

examples.en: I strained my back while lifting that heavy box.
examples.zh: 我搬那个沉重的箱子时拉伤了背部。

examples.en: Rapid population growth puts considerable strain on public services, particularly housing and healthcare in large cities.
examples.zh: 人口快速增长给公共服务带来巨大压力，尤其是大城市的住房和医疗服务。

collocations: put a strain on｜给……造成压力
a strain of virus｜一种病毒株

senses.en: a two-player board game involving pieces with different permitted moves

examples.en: My grandfather taught me chess during the winter holidays.
examples.zh: 寒假期间，爷爷教我下国际象棋。

examples.en: Playing chess regularly may help children develop concentration and practise planning several steps ahead.
examples.zh: 经常下国际象棋可能有助于儿童提高专注力，并练习提前规划多个步骤。

senses.en: A sport involving hitting a shuttlecock over a net with rackets

examples.en: We play badminton at the sports centre every Saturday.
examples.zh: 我们每周六都在体育中心打羽毛球。

examples.en: Schools can encourage regular exercise by offering accessible activities such as badminton and swimming.
examples.zh: 学校可以通过提供羽毛球和游泳等易于参与的活动来鼓励学生经常锻炼。

senses.en: A sport hitting a small ball into holes with clubs

examples.en: My grandfather plays golf with his friends every Sunday.
examples.zh: 我祖父每周日都和朋友打高尔夫球。

examples.en: Golf courses can attract tourists, but maintaining their grass may require considerable amounts of water.
examples.zh: 高尔夫球场可以吸引游客，但养护草坪可能需要大量用水。

collocations: a golf club｜高尔夫球杆；高尔夫俱乐部
a round of golf｜一轮高尔夫球

senses.en: A game where two teams kick a ball into goals.

examples.en: We play soccer in the park every Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 我们每周六早上都在公园踢足球。

examples.en: Community soccer clubs provide affordable exercise and help young people develop teamwork skills outside the classroom.
examples.zh: 社区足球俱乐部提供费用低廉的锻炼机会，帮助年轻人在课堂之外培养团队协作能力。

senses.en: a sport involving hitting a ball over a net with rackets

examples.en: We play tennis at the park on Sundays.
examples.zh: 我们每逢周日都在公园打网球。

examples.en: Providing affordable tennis lessons can encourage young people to exercise regularly and develop greater physical coordination.
examples.zh: 提供价格实惠的网球课程，可以鼓励年轻人经常锻炼并提高身体协调能力。

senses.en: A game of hitting a ball over a high net.

examples.en: We played volleyball on the beach until the sun set.
examples.zh: 我们在沙滩上打排球，一直打到日落。

examples.en: Team sports such as volleyball can help students develop communication skills while encouraging regular physical activity.
examples.zh: 排球等团队运动既能帮助学生培养沟通能力，也能鼓励他们定期锻炼。

senses.en: A team sport using sticks to hit a ball or puck

examples.en: We practised hockey on the school field yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我们在学校运动场练习了曲棍球。

examples.en: Making hockey facilities more accessible could encourage greater participation in team sports among young people.
examples.zh: 让曲棍球设施更便于使用，可以鼓励更多年轻人参加团队运动。

senses.en: Something you want to accomplish through effort.
A score made by sending a ball into a goal.
A frame or area players aim to send a ball into.

examples.en: My goal is to swim across the pool unaided.
examples.zh: 我的目标是不靠帮助游到泳池对面。

examples.en: Setting realistic goals can help university students manage their time and maintain motivation during demanding courses.
examples.zh: 设定切合实际的目标能帮助大学生管理时间，并在繁重的课程学习中保持动力。

senses.en: A flying mammal usually active at night.
An object used to hit the ball in certain sports.
To hit or try to hit a ball with a bat.

examples.en: A bat flew above our garden at dusk.
examples.zh: 黄昏时，一只蝙蝠从我们花园上方飞过。

examples.en: Protecting bat habitats can benefit agriculture because many species feed on insects that damage crops.
examples.zh: 保护蝙蝠栖息地能使农业受益，因为许多蝙蝠以危害农作物的昆虫为食。

senses.en: An object with strings used to hit balls in sports.
A loud, unpleasant noise.

examples.en: I left my tennis racket beside the court.
examples.zh: 我把网球拍落在球场边了。

examples.en: Providing basic equipment, such as a racket, can make school sports more accessible to children.
examples.zh: 提供球拍等基本器材，可以让更多孩子参与学校体育活动。

senses.en: to hit something with your foot
an act of hitting something with your foot

examples.en: She kicked the ball gently towards her little brother.
examples.zh: 她轻轻地把球踢向弟弟。

examples.en: Children learn to kick and throw balls through activities that improve coordination and encourage teamwork.
examples.zh: 孩子们通过能够改善协调能力、培养团队精神的活动学习踢球和投球。

senses.en: to hit a surface, especially a door, to make a sound
to hit something accidentally, often making it move or fall
a sound or blow caused by hitting something

examples.en: Please knock on the door before you come in.
examples.zh: 进来之前请先敲门。

examples.en: Strong winds can knock down trees, causing serious disruption to transport networks in urban areas.
examples.zh: 强风可能刮倒树木，严重扰乱城市地区的交通网络。

collocations: a loud knock｜响亮的敲击声

senses.en: An area of ground used for outdoor team sports.
How high or low a sound is.
Present an idea or product to persuade someone to accept it.

examples.en: The players ran onto the pitch despite the rain.
examples.zh: 尽管下着雨，球员们还是跑进了球场。

examples.en: Young entrepreneurs often pitch their business ideas to investors who can provide funding and practical guidance.
examples.zh: 年轻创业者经常向能够提供资金和实用指导的投资者推介商业构想。

senses.en: To send something through the air using your hand
To organise and host a party
An act of throwing, or the distance something is thrown

examples.en: Throw me the ball before the dog grabs it.
examples.zh: 趁狗还没抢到球，快把球扔给我。

examples.en: Schools can teach children to throw and catch safely through games that develop coordination and teamwork.
examples.zh: 学校可以通过培养协调能力和团队精神的游戏，教孩子安全地投接球。

senses.en: To throw something lightly or without much care.
To turn food over gently to mix or coat it.
An act of throwing something lightly.

examples.en: Could you toss me that cushion from the sofa?
examples.zh: 你能把沙发上的那个靠垫扔给我吗？

examples.en: Consumers often toss usable items into the bin, increasing waste that could be avoided through repair.
examples.zh: 消费者常把还能用的物品扔进垃圾桶，增加了本可通过维修避免的废弃物。

senses.en: to move smoothly across a surface without lifting
a single image or page shown during a presentation
a sloping structure that children slide down

examples.en: She slid the plate across the table towards me.
examples.zh: 她把盘子沿着桌面推滑到我面前。

examples.en: Teachers can use a carefully designed slide to explain complex scientific processes more clearly.
examples.zh: 教师可以用精心设计的幻灯片更清楚地解释复杂的科学过程。

senses.en: To slide accidentally, losing balance or leaving a position.
To move or put something somewhere quietly or quickly.
A small piece of paper, or a minor mistake.

examples.en: I slipped on the wet floor but stayed upright.
examples.zh: 我在湿地板上滑了一下，但没有摔倒。

examples.en: Hospitals should keep floors dry to reduce the risk of patients slipping and injuring themselves.
examples.zh: 医院应保持地面干燥，以降低病人滑倒受伤的风险。

collocations: slip into a room｜悄悄进入房间
a slip of paper｜一张小纸条
a slip of the tongue｜口误

senses.en: To move smoothly and easily, often without much noise.
To fly without engine power or without moving the wings.

examples.en: The swan glided across the pond towards the reeds.
examples.zh: 天鹅平稳地游过池塘，朝芦苇丛靠近。

examples.en: Large birds conserve energy by gliding on rising air currents rather than continuously flapping their wings.
examples.zh: 大型鸟类借助上升气流滑翔，而不是持续拍打翅膀，以此节省能量。

collocations: glide through the air｜在空中滑翔

senses.en: to move over snow wearing long narrow boards on your feet
a long narrow board worn on a foot for travelling over snow

examples.en: We learned to ski on a gentle snowy slope.
examples.zh: 我们在一处平缓的雪坡上学会了滑雪。

examples.en: Tourists who ski in mountain resorts contribute to local employment but may also increase environmental pressure.
examples.zh: 在山地度假区滑雪的游客促进了当地就业，但也可能增加环境压力。

collocations: a pair of skis｜一副滑雪板

senses.en: to move over ice or ground wearing special wheeled or bladed shoes
a boot with a blade or wheels for moving smoothly

examples.en: We skate around the rink every Saturday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我们每周六下午都在溜冰场滑冰。

examples.en: Public facilities where children can skate safely encourage physical activity and provide affordable recreation for families.
examples.zh: 供儿童安全滑冰的公共设施能鼓励体育活动，并为家庭提供经济实惠的娱乐选择。

collocations: a pair of skates｜一双溜冰鞋

senses.en: The activity of riding a bicycle for transport or exercise.

examples.en: We go cycling beside the river every Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 我们每个星期天早上都沿河骑自行车。

examples.en: Investing in safe cycling routes can encourage commuters to choose healthier and less polluting forms of transport.
examples.zh: 投资建设安全的自行车道可以鼓励通勤者选择更健康、污染更少的交通方式。

senses.en: to enter water headfirst or swim beneath its surface
to move downwards suddenly and quickly
an act of diving or a sudden sharp fall

examples.en: We watched a swimmer dive smoothly into the pool.
examples.zh: 我们看着一名游泳者流畅地跃入泳池。

examples.en: Tourists who dive near coral reefs should avoid touching marine organisms to prevent damage to fragile ecosystems.
examples.zh: 在珊瑚礁附近潜水的游客应避免触碰海洋生物，以免破坏脆弱的生态系统。

collocations: dive into the water｜跃入水中

senses.en: To move slowly, carried by water or air.
To move or change gradually without clear purpose or control.
The general meaning of what someone says or writes.

examples.en: We watched a fallen leaf drift across the pond.
examples.zh: 我们看着一片落叶缓缓漂过池塘。

examples.en: Without affordable housing and stable employment, young residents may gradually drift away from rural communities.
examples.zh: 如果缺乏负担得起的住房和稳定的工作，年轻居民可能会逐渐离开农村社区。

collocations: drift off to sleep｜渐渐入睡

senses.en: To push yourself off the ground into the air.
To increase suddenly by a large amount.
An act of jumping or a sudden large increase.

examples.en: The dog jumped over a puddle beside the gate.
examples.zh: 狗跳过了大门旁的一摊积水。

examples.en: Housing costs have jumped sharply in cities where demand continues to exceed the supply of affordable homes.
examples.zh: 在住房需求持续超过可负担住房供应的城市，住房成本已大幅上涨。

collocations: jump over a fence｜跳过篱笆
jump at the chance｜欣然抓住机会
a sharp jump in prices｜价格的猛涨

senses.en: To move or push something suddenly and forcefully into something.
To decrease suddenly and sharply.
A sudden dive, fall, or sharp decrease.

examples.en: He plunged his muddy boots into a bucket of water.
examples.zh: 他把沾满泥的靴子猛地浸进一桶水里。

examples.en: Tourism revenue may plunge when extreme weather forces popular coastal resorts to close during peak season.
examples.zh: 当极端天气迫使热门海滨度假区在旺季关闭时，旅游收入可能骤降。

collocations: plunge into water｜猛地跳入水中
take the plunge｜下决心冒险尝试

senses.en: To jump on one foot or make small jumps.
A small jump, especially one made on one foot.
To get on or off a vehicle quickly and easily.

examples.en: The little bird hopped across the wet garden path.
examples.zh: 那只小鸟蹦跳着穿过湿漉漉的花园小径。

examples.en: Activities that encourage children to hop and balance can support physical development in early education.
examples.zh: 在早期教育中，鼓励儿童单脚跳和平衡身体的活动有助于身体发育。

collocations: hop on a bus｜迅速上公交车

senses.en: move back up after hitting a surface, or cause this
a movement back up after hitting a surface
be rejected by a bank because funds are insufficient

examples.en: The ball bounced over the fence into our neighbour's garden.
examples.zh: 球弹过篱笆，落进了邻居的花园。

examples.en: Local businesses can bounce back after economic shocks if they receive timely financial support.
examples.zh: 如果及时获得资金支持，当地企业就能在经济冲击后恢复元气。

collocations: bounce ideas off someone｜与某人交流想法

senses.en: a portable fabric shelter supported by poles and ropes

examples.en: We pitched our tent beside a quiet lake.
examples.zh: 我们在一个宁静的湖边搭起帐篷。

examples.en: Visitors who sleep in a tent should follow campsite rules to minimise their impact on local wildlife.
examples.zh: 住帐篷的游客应遵守营地规定，尽量减少对当地野生动物的影响。

collocations: put up a tent｜搭起帐篷

senses.en: A place where people stay temporarily, often in tents.
Stay outdoors temporarily in a tent or similar shelter.
A group sharing the same opinions or aims.

examples.en: We returned to camp before the rain started.
examples.zh: 我们在下雨前回到了营地。

examples.en: Schools can organise outdoor camps to help students develop independence and learn practical skills beyond the classroom.
examples.zh: 学校可以组织户外营地活动，帮助学生培养独立性并学习课堂之外的实用技能。

senses.en: a meal eaten outdoors, usually with food brought from home
to eat a meal outdoors for pleasure

examples.en: We had a picnic under a shady tree.
examples.zh: 我们在一棵树的荫凉下野餐。

examples.en: Public parks provide affordable spaces where families can enjoy picnics and spend quality time together.
examples.zh: 公共公园提供了花费不高的空间，让家庭享受野餐并共度美好时光。

senses.en: to chase wild animals to catch or kill them
to search carefully for someone or something
an organised search or an activity involving chasing wild animals

examples.en: We hunted for my keys under the sofa.
examples.zh: 我们在沙发底下找我的钥匙。

examples.en: When natural habitats shrink, predators may hunt closer to farms, increasing conflict between wildlife and local communities.
examples.zh: 自然栖息地缩小时，捕食动物可能到更靠近农场的地方捕猎，加剧野生动物与当地社区的冲突。

collocations: hunt wild animals｜猎捕野生动物

senses.en: A competition to see who finishes a course fastest.
A social grouping based on perceived shared ancestry and physical characteristics.
To compete in speed or move very quickly.

examples.en: We watched the boat race from the bridge.
examples.zh: 我们在桥上观看了划船比赛。

examples.en: Schools should ensure that all children receive equal educational opportunities, regardless of their race or family income.
examples.zh: 学校应确保所有儿童都享有平等的教育机会，不论其种族或家庭收入。

senses.en: a person walking rather than travelling in a vehicle
intended for or relating to people travelling on foot
ordinary and lacking imagination or excitement

examples.en: The driver stopped to let a pedestrian cross.
examples.zh: 司机停车让一位行人过马路。

examples.en: Wider pavements and safer crossings can protect pedestrians and encourage residents to walk instead of driving.
examples.zh: 更宽的人行道和更安全的过街设施可以保护行人，鼓励居民步行而非开车。

senses.en: The speed at which someone moves or something happens
A single step taken when walking
To walk repeatedly back and forth, often when worried

examples.en: We slowed our pace so Grandma could catch up.
examples.zh: 我们放慢脚步，好让奶奶跟上。

examples.en: The rapid pace of technological change requires workers to update their skills throughout their careers.
examples.zh: 技术变革的快速步伐要求劳动者在整个职业生涯中不断更新技能。

collocations: at your own pace｜按自己的节奏
the pace of change｜变化的速度
pace up and down｜来回踱步

senses.en: a foot movement when walking, or a stair surface
one action in a process or towards a goal
to move by lifting and placing your foot

examples.en: Take one step forward and close the door.
examples.zh: 向前迈一步，把门关上。

examples.en: Improving public transport is an important step towards reducing traffic congestion and air pollution in cities.
examples.zh: 改善公共交通是减少城市交通拥堵和空气污染的重要一步。

collocations: take a step｜迈一步；采取措施

senses.en: A short journey made for pleasure, often with a group.

examples.en: We packed sandwiches for our excursion to the lake.
examples.zh: 我们为去湖边的短途旅行准备了三明治。

examples.en: School excursions to nature reserves can deepen students' understanding of local wildlife and conservation.
examples.zh: 学校组织的自然保护区游览能加深学生对当地野生生物及其保护的理解。

collocations: go on an excursion｜去短途旅行
a school excursion｜学校组织的游览

senses.en: a holiday travelling by ship and visiting different places
to travel smoothly at a steady speed

examples.en: We took a cruise around the islands last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天，我们乘船游览了那些岛屿。

examples.en: The growing popularity of cruise holidays has raised concerns about air pollution in coastal cities.
examples.zh: 邮轮度假日益流行，引发了人们对沿海城市空气污染的担忧。

collocations: go on a cruise｜乘邮轮旅行

senses.en: a journey to a place and usually back again
to stumble or make someone stumble by catching a foot

examples.en: Our weekend trip to the coast was wonderfully relaxing.
examples.zh: 我们周末的海滨之旅让人十分放松。

examples.en: School trips to museums can enrich classroom learning by giving students direct access to historical objects.
examples.zh: 学校组织的博物馆参观能让学生直接接触历史实物，从而丰富课堂学习。

senses.en: time away from work or study for rest or travel
to spend a holiday somewhere away from home

examples.en: We spent our summer vacation camping beside a lake.
examples.zh: 我们暑假在湖边露营。

examples.en: Taking a regular vacation may improve employees' mental health and help them return to work with greater motivation.
examples.zh: 定期休假可能改善员工的心理健康，并让他们回到工作岗位时更有动力。

senses.en: A long walk, usually through the countryside or mountains.
To walk a long distance, especially in natural surroundings.
A large increase in a price, cost, or rate.

examples.en: Our weekend hike ended beside a clear mountain lake.
examples.zh: 我们周末的徒步旅行在一片清澈的山间湖泊旁结束。

examples.en: A sharp hike in public transport fares could discourage commuters from choosing buses over private cars.
examples.zh: 公共交通票价大幅上涨可能会降低通勤者选择公交车而非私家车的意愿。

senses.en: To run slowly and steadily, usually for exercise.
A period of slow, steady running.
To knock or push something slightly, often accidentally.

examples.en: We jog around the park before breakfast every morning.
examples.zh: 我们每天早饭前都绕着公园慢跑。

examples.en: People who jog regularly may improve their cardiovascular health without needing expensive equipment or gym memberships.
examples.zh: 经常慢跑的人无需昂贵的器材或健身房会员资格，也能改善心血管健康。

collocations: jog someone's memory｜唤起某人的记忆

senses.en: Walk with long, confident steps.
A long step taken while walking or running.
Important progress towards a goal, usually expressed in the plural.

examples.en: Leila strode across the platform to catch her train.
examples.zh: 莱拉大步穿过站台去赶火车。

examples.en: Many countries have made significant strides in improving access to primary education over recent decades.
examples.zh: 近几十年来，许多国家在扩大初等教育机会方面取得了显著进展。

collocations: stride across a room｜大步穿过房间
make great strides｜取得巨大进展
take something in your stride｜从容应对某事

senses.en: to move around without a fixed route or purpose
to stop concentrating or move away from the main subject

examples.en: We wandered through the market and bought some peaches.
examples.zh: 我们在市场里闲逛，买了些桃子。

examples.en: Visitors who wander beyond popular tourist areas often discover local businesses that benefit from additional spending.
examples.zh: 走出热门旅游区随意逛逛的游客，常能发现一些因额外消费而受益的当地商家。

collocations: let your mind wander｜任思绪游走
wander off the subject｜偏离话题

senses.en: To stay somewhere longer than expected or necessary.
To remain present or noticeable for a long time.

examples.en: We lingered outside the cinema, chatting about the film.
examples.zh: 我们在电影院外迟迟没有离开，聊着刚看的电影。

examples.en: The effects of prolonged unemployment can linger even after individuals return to stable work.
examples.zh: 长期失业的影响即使在人们重新获得稳定工作后，也可能持续存在。

collocations: linger over a meal｜慢慢吃饭不急着离开
linger in the air｜在空气中久久不散

senses.en: Move or develop more slowly than others
A delay between related actions, events, or changes

examples.en: I always lag behind my sister on steep hills.
examples.zh: 走陡坡时，我总是落在姐姐后面。

examples.en: Investment in rural transport often lags behind urban development, limiting access to jobs and essential services.
examples.zh: 农村交通投资往往落后于城市发展，限制了人们获得工作和基本服务的机会。

collocations: a lag in development｜发展滞后

senses.en: to move upwards using your feet and often your hands
to increase in amount or level
an act of moving upwards or an increase in level

examples.en: We climbed the hill before stopping for a picnic.
examples.zh: 我们爬上山坡，然后停下来野餐。

examples.en: As housing costs continue to climb, many young adults struggle to live independently in major cities.
examples.zh: 随着住房成本持续上涨，许多年轻人难以在大城市独立生活。

collocations: a steep climb｜陡峭的攀登路段

senses.en: to move something towards you or along by holding it
an act of pulling or a force drawing something closer
to injure a muscle by stretching it too much

examples.en: Please pull the door gently instead of pushing it.
examples.zh: 请轻轻拉门，不要推。

examples.en: Horses once pulled heavy loads through cities, but motor vehicles eventually replaced them in most transport roles.
examples.zh: 马匹曾在城市中拉运重物，但机动车最终取代了它们的大部分运输职能。

collocations: pull a door open｜把门拉开

senses.en: To pull something along a surface, often with effort.
To pass or progress so slowly that it feels boring.
A force or influence that slows movement or progress.

examples.en: We dragged the heavy rug across the floor.
examples.zh: 我们拖着沉重的地毯穿过房间。

examples.en: Complicated approval procedures can drag on for months, delaying essential improvements to public transport.
examples.zh: 复杂的审批程序可能拖延数月，耽误公共交通的必要改善。

collocations: a drag on growth｜增长的拖累

senses.en: To become curved or make something curved.
To move your body downwards or forwards from the waist.
A curved section of a road, river, or other long object.

examples.en: Bend the wire gently to make a small hook.
examples.zh: 轻轻弯曲铁丝，做成一个小钩子。

examples.en: Drivers should reduce their speed before approaching a sharp bend, especially when road conditions are poor.
examples.zh: 驾驶员在接近急弯前应减速，尤其是在路况不佳时。

senses.en: A curved weapon with a string used to shoot arrows.
A knot with two loops and two loose ends.
To bend your head or body forward, often showing respect.

examples.en: She tied a neat bow around the gift box.
examples.zh: 她在礼盒上系了一个整齐的蝴蝶结。

examples.en: In some cultures, people bow when greeting others, while elsewhere a handshake is more common.
examples.zh: 在一些文化中，人们见面时会鞠躬，而在其他地方，握手更常见。

senses.en: Things or materials referred to without naming them specifically.
To fill something tightly or push something into a space.

examples.en: Please move your stuff off the kitchen table.
examples.zh: 请把你的东西从厨房餐桌上拿走。

examples.en: Consumers often buy stuff they rarely use, contributing to household waste and unnecessary resource consumption.
examples.zh: 消费者经常购买很少使用的东西，造成家庭浪费和不必要的资源消耗。

collocations: stuff a bag with｜用……塞满袋子

senses.en: A single object, especially one in a collection.
One part of a list, programme, or news report.

examples.en: Please place each item carefully in the shopping bag.
examples.zh: 请把每件商品小心地放进购物袋。

examples.en: Each item on the meeting agenda addresses a different challenge facing local public transport services.
examples.zh: 会议议程中的每一项都涉及当地公共交通服务面临的不同挑战。

senses.en: goods available for sale
to promote goods and encourage people to buy them

examples.en: The shop displays its new merchandise near the entrance.
examples.zh: 这家店在入口附近陈列新商品。

examples.en: Selling locally produced merchandise can support small businesses and reduce the environmental impact of transport.
examples.zh: 销售本地生产的商品可以扶持小企业，并减少运输对环境的影响。

senses.en: An object kept to remember a place, person, or event.

examples.en: We bought a small wooden boat as a souvenir.
examples.zh: 我们买了一只小木船作为纪念品。

examples.en: Buying a locally made souvenir can support traditional crafts and provide income for communities that depend on tourism.
examples.zh: 购买当地制作的纪念品可以支持传统工艺，并为依靠旅游业的社区带来收入。

senses.en: A substance used to make things, including cloth.
Information or ideas used for study or creative work.
Relating to physical possessions, or significant enough to matter.

examples.en: This bag is made from a strong waterproof material.
examples.zh: 这个包用结实的防水材料制成。

examples.en: Using recycled material in construction can reduce waste and lower demand for newly extracted natural resources.
examples.zh: 在建筑中使用再生材料可以减少废弃物，并降低对新开采自然资源的需求。

senses.en: not cooked
in its original state before processing or analysis
sore because the skin is damaged or irritated

examples.en: I prefer raw carrots because they are so crunchy.
examples.zh: 我更喜欢生胡萝卜，因为吃起来很脆。

examples.en: Countries that export mainly raw materials may be vulnerable to sudden changes in global commodity prices.
examples.zh: 主要出口原材料的国家可能容易受到全球大宗商品价格骤变的冲击。

senses.en: the need for something or for something to happen
something essential for everyday life

examples.en: Living far from town makes a car a necessity.
examples.zh: 住得离城镇很远，汽车就成了必需品。

examples.en: The rising cost of housing highlights the necessity of providing affordable homes for low-income families.
examples.zh: 住房成本上涨凸显了为低收入家庭提供可负担住房的必要性。

collocations: a necessity for｜对……而言的必需品

senses.en: A set of clothes worn together for a particular occasion.
To provide someone or something with necessary equipment or clothes.
A group or organization working together, used informally.

examples.en: She chose a bright outfit for her birthday party.
examples.zh: 她为自己的生日聚会挑了一套鲜艳的衣服。

examples.en: Schools should outfit science laboratories with modern equipment so that students can develop practical research skills.
examples.zh: 学校应为科学实验室配备现代设备，让学生能够培养实际研究技能。

collocations: matching outfit｜搭配协调的全套服装
outfit something with equipment｜为某物配备设备

senses.en: A set of tools or equipment for a particular activity
A set of parts used to build something

examples.en: We keep a first aid kit in the car.
examples.zh: 我们在车里备有一个急救包。

examples.en: Schools should provide basic science kits so that all pupils can take part in practical experiments.
examples.zh: 学校应提供基础科学实验套件，让所有学生都能参与动手实验。

collocations: kit someone out｜给某人配齐装备

senses.en: waste material that people throw away
something considered untrue, useless, or very poor in quality

examples.en: Please take the garbage out before it starts smelling.
examples.zh: 请在垃圾发臭之前把它拿出去。

examples.en: Cities can reduce the amount of garbage sent to landfill by improving recycling facilities and public awareness.
examples.zh: 城市可以通过改善回收设施和提高公众意识，减少运往填埋场的垃圾量。

collocations: take out the garbage｜把垃圾拿出去

senses.en: Things people throw away because they no longer need them.
Ideas or statements that are silly or untrue.

examples.en: Please put your rubbish in the bin outside.
examples.zh: 请把垃圾放进外面的垃圾桶。

examples.en: Reducing household rubbish requires both convenient recycling facilities and greater public awareness of unnecessary packaging.
examples.zh: 减少生活垃圾既需要便利的回收设施，也需要提高公众对过度包装的认识。

senses.en: to process used materials so they can be used again

examples.en: We recycle glass bottles at the centre near our house.
examples.zh: 我们把玻璃瓶送到家附近的回收中心回收。

examples.en: Cities can reduce landfill waste by making it easier for residents to recycle everyday packaging.
examples.zh: 城市可以通过方便居民回收日常包装来减少填埋垃圾。

collocations: recycle household waste｜回收生活垃圾

senses.en: Waste left scattered in public places.
To leave rubbish or other objects scattered across a place.
A group of young animals born to one mother together.

examples.en: We picked up litter along the beach before lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭前，我们沿着海滩捡垃圾。

examples.en: Reducing litter in urban parks requires convenient bins as well as sustained public education campaigns.
examples.zh: 减少城市公园里乱扔的垃圾，需要设置便于使用的垃圾桶，并持续开展公众教育活动。

collocations: a litter of puppies｜一窝小狗

senses.en: Use more of something than necessary or without useful results.
Unwanted material left after something has been used or made.
An unnecessary or unproductive use of time, money, or resources.

examples.en: Don't waste water by leaving the tap running.
examples.zh: 别让水龙头一直开着，白白浪费水。

examples.en: Reducing household waste requires both convenient recycling facilities and greater public awareness of responsible consumption.
examples.zh: 减少生活垃圾既需要便利的回收设施，也需要提高公众的负责任消费意识。

collocations: a waste of money｜浪费金钱

senses.en: A place where waste is buried in the ground.
The disposal of waste by burying it in the ground.

examples.en: The truck carried our rubbish to a nearby landfill.
examples.zh: 卡车把我们的垃圾运到了附近的填埋场。

examples.en: Expanding recycling services could reduce the amount of household waste sent to landfill each year.
examples.zh: 扩大回收服务范围可以减少每年送去填埋的生活垃圾量。

collocations: send waste to landfill｜将垃圾送去填埋

senses.en: a substance used with water to clean clothes or surfaces

examples.en: I added detergent before starting the washing machine.
examples.zh: 我在启动洗衣机之前加入了洗涤剂。

examples.en: Using excessive detergent wastes money and may increase the amount of chemicals entering local waterways.
examples.zh: 使用过量洗涤剂既浪费钱，也可能增加进入当地水道的化学物质。

senses.en: a liquid product used to wash hair
to wash hair using shampoo

examples.en: I packed a small bottle of shampoo for our trip.
examples.zh: 我为这次旅行装了一小瓶洗发水。

examples.en: Using refillable shampoo containers can reduce plastic waste generated by households and the tourism industry.
examples.zh: 使用可补充装的洗发水容器可以减少家庭和旅游业产生的塑料垃圾。

collocations: a bottle of shampoo｜一瓶洗发水
shampoo your hair｜用洗发水洗头

senses.en: A substance used with water to clean skin or objects.
A continuing television or radio drama about everyday relationships.
To rub or wash something with soap.

examples.en: Please wash your hands with soap before lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭前请用肥皂洗手。

examples.en: Providing clean water and soap in schools can help prevent infections and improve children's overall health.
examples.zh: 在学校提供清洁用水和肥皂有助于预防感染，改善儿童的整体健康状况。

collocations: a bar of soap｜一块肥皂

senses.en: A device connecting electrical equipment to a power socket.
An object fitted into a hole to stop liquid escaping.
To fill or block a hole or gap.

examples.en: Pull the plug out before you clean the toaster.
examples.zh: 清洁烤面包机前，先拔掉插头。

examples.en: Households can reduce some unnecessary electricity consumption by removing plugs from sockets when appliances are not in use.
examples.zh: 家电不用时拔掉插头，家庭就能减少一些不必要的耗电。

collocations: pull out the plug｜拔出插头
plug something in｜给某物接通电源

senses.en: a device that controls water flowing from a pipe
to touch or hit something lightly
to use an available source of energy, knowledge, or resources

examples.en: Please turn off the tap while brushing your teeth.
examples.zh: 刷牙时请关上水龙头。

examples.en: Universities can tap local expertise to develop practical solutions to environmental problems affecting nearby communities.
examples.zh: 大学可以利用当地的专业知识，为影响周边社区的环境问题制定切实可行的解决方案。

collocations: turn off the tap｜关上水龙头
tap someone on the shoulder｜轻拍某人的肩膀

senses.en: A hollow tube that carries liquid or gas.
To carry liquid or gas through pipes.
A small bowl with a tube used for smoking tobacco.

examples.en: Water dripped from a broken pipe under the sink.
examples.zh: 水从洗涤槽下面一根破裂的管子里滴下来。

examples.en: Replacing damaged water pipes can help cities conserve resources and ensure a reliable supply of clean drinking water.
examples.zh: 更换受损水管可以帮助城市节约资源，并确保清洁饮用水的可靠供应。

collocations: pipe water to｜用管道把水输送到

senses.en: a long, hollow object that carries liquids or gases
a soft container squeezed to release paste or cream
the underground railway system in London

examples.en: Water flowed through a clear tube into the tank.
examples.zh: 水通过一根透明管子流进了水箱。

examples.en: Taking the tube instead of driving can help commuters avoid congestion in central London.
examples.zh: 乘地铁而不是开车可以帮助通勤者避开伦敦市中心的交通拥堵。

collocations: a tube of toothpaste｜一管牙膏

senses.en: A long-handled tool for washing floors
To clean a surface or remove liquid with absorbent material

examples.en: I used a mop to clean the muddy kitchen floor.
examples.zh: 我用拖把擦洗了沾满泥的厨房地板。

examples.en: Staff should mop shared floors regularly to maintain hygiene in schools and other public buildings.
examples.zh: 工作人员应定期拖洗公共区域的地面，以保持学校及其他公共建筑的卫生。

collocations: mop up a spill｜擦净洒出的液体
a mop and bucket｜拖把和水桶

senses.en: to clean a surface using a brush or broom
to move quickly and powerfully across an area

examples.en: Please sweep the kitchen floor before our guests arrive.
examples.zh: 请在客人到来前把厨房地板扫干净。

examples.en: Severe storms can sweep across coastal regions, damaging homes and disrupting essential transport services.
examples.zh: 猛烈的风暴可能席卷沿海地区，损坏房屋并扰乱重要的交通服务。

senses.en: A thick woven covering for a floor.

examples.en: We sat on the carpet and played cards.
examples.zh: 我们坐在地毯上打牌。

examples.en: Installing carpet in classrooms can reduce noise, although regular cleaning is necessary to maintain good hygiene.
examples.zh: 在教室里铺地毯可以降低噪声，但需要定期清洁以保持良好卫生。

senses.en: a movable covering for part of a floor
a thick blanket used for warmth

examples.en: The cat curled up on the rug beside the sofa.
examples.zh: 猫蜷卧在沙发旁的小地毯上。

examples.en: Placing a rug on a hard floor can reduce noise and make shared housing more comfortable.
examples.zh: 在硬地板上铺一块小地毯可以降低噪声，让合住空间更舒适。

collocations: a hearth rug｜壁炉前的小地毯

senses.en: A piece of material covering or protecting a surface.
To twist hair or fibres into a thick tangled mass.

examples.en: Please wipe your shoes on the mat before entering.
examples.zh: 进门前请在垫子上擦擦鞋。

examples.en: Placing a rubber mat near each entrance can help prevent slips in busy public buildings.
examples.zh: 在每个入口附近放置橡胶垫，有助于防止人们在繁忙的公共建筑内滑倒。

senses.en: A soft filled bag used for comfort or support.
To soften an impact or reduce a harmful effect.
Something that protects against difficulty, loss, or sudden change.

examples.en: She put a soft cushion behind her back.
examples.zh: 她在背后放了一个柔软的靠垫。

examples.en: Emergency savings can cushion the financial impact of unemployment and help families maintain their living standards.
examples.zh: 应急储蓄可以减轻失业带来的经济冲击，帮助家庭维持生活水平。

senses.en: A thick bed covering, or a layer covering something.
Applying to everyone or everything without considering individual differences.
To cover something completely with a layer.

examples.en: She wrapped a soft blanket around her cold shoulders.
examples.zh: 她用一条柔软的毯子裹住冰凉的肩膀。

examples.en: A blanket ban on private vehicles may disadvantage residents who cannot easily access public transport.
examples.zh: 全面禁止私家车可能使难以使用公共交通的居民处于不利地位。

collocations: a blanket of snow｜厚厚的一层雪

senses.en: A large piece of cloth used to cover a bed.
A thin, flat piece of paper, metal, or another material.

examples.en: I spread a clean sheet over the mattress.
examples.zh: 我在床垫上铺了一条干净的床单。

examples.en: Schools can reduce paper waste by encouraging students to use both sides of each sheet.
examples.zh: 学校可以鼓励学生使用每张纸的正反两面，以减少纸张浪费。

collocations: a sheet of glass｜一块玻璃

senses.en: A soft support for your head when resting or sleeping.

examples.en: She placed a fresh pillow on the guest bed.
examples.zh: 她在客床上放了一个干净的枕头。

examples.en: Choosing a supportive pillow may improve sleep quality by helping maintain a comfortable neck position.
examples.zh: 选择支撑性好的枕头，有助于保持舒适的颈部姿势，从而可能改善睡眠质量。

senses.en: A soft material full of holes that absorbs liquid.
A simple aquatic animal with many pores in its body.
To clean or wipe something using a damp sponge.

examples.en: Use a damp sponge to wipe the kitchen table.
examples.zh: 用湿海绵擦一下厨房的桌子。

examples.en: Urban wetlands act like a sponge, absorbing excess rainwater and reducing the risk of flooding.
examples.zh: 城市湿地就像海绵，能吸收多余的雨水，降低洪涝风险。

collocations: squeeze out a sponge｜挤干海绵
sponge something down｜用湿海绵擦洗某物

senses.en: a piece of absorbent cloth used for drying things
to dry someone or something with a towel

examples.en: He wrapped a warm towel around his wet shoulders.
examples.zh: 他把一条温暖的毛巾裹在湿漉漉的肩膀上。

examples.en: Hotels can reduce water consumption by encouraging guests to reuse their towels during their stay.
examples.zh: 酒店可以鼓励住客在入住期间重复使用毛巾，以减少用水量。

senses.en: The hard covering at the end of a finger or toe.
A thin pointed metal piece used to fasten materials together.
To attach something using nails.

examples.en: I cut my nails before my piano lesson.
examples.zh: 我在上钢琴课前剪了指甲。

examples.en: Teaching children to keep their nails clean can help establish healthy personal hygiene habits early.
examples.zh: 教孩子保持指甲清洁，有助于他们尽早养成良好的个人卫生习惯。

senses.en: A tool with a sharp blade used to shave hair.

examples.en: He rinsed his razor and put it beside the sink.
examples.zh: 他冲洗了剃须刀，把它放在洗手池旁。

examples.en: Choosing a reusable razor can reduce the amount of plastic waste generated by daily grooming.
examples.zh: 选择可重复使用的剃须刀，可以减少日常个人护理产生的塑料垃圾。

senses.en: To remove hair from skin using a razor.
To remove thin pieces or reduce something by a small amount.
An act of removing facial hair with a razor.

examples.en: I shave every morning before leaving for work.
examples.zh: 我每天早晨出门上班前都会刮胡子。

examples.en: Improved transport connections could shave several minutes off daily journeys and encourage more people to commute by train.
examples.zh: 改善交通衔接可以缩短几分钟的日常行程，并鼓励更多人乘火车通勤。

senses.en: A safety device that breaks a circuit when current is excessive.
To join together into one whole, often through heat.
A cord or device that makes an explosive charge go off.

examples.en: The electrician replaced the fuse, and the lights came on.
examples.zh: 电工换了保险丝，灯就亮了。

examples.en: Modern design often fuses traditional craftsmanship with digital technology to create more sustainable consumer products.
examples.zh: 现代设计常将传统工艺与数字技术融合，以创造更可持续的消费品。

collocations: blow a fuse｜烧断保险丝；大发雷霆

senses.en: covered wires carrying electricity or electronic signals
a thick strong rope, usually made of metal wires

examples.en: The charging cable was tangled beneath my desk.
examples.zh: 充电线在我的书桌下面缠成了一团。

examples.en: Undersea cable networks carry vast amounts of data, making them essential infrastructure for international communication and trade.
examples.zh: 海底电缆网络传输大量数据，是国际通信和贸易不可或缺的基础设施。

senses.en: A single thin length of hair, thread, or similar material.
One element within a larger argument, story, or activity.
To leave someone somewhere without a way to leave.

examples.en: A strand of hair fell across her face.
examples.zh: 一缕头发垂到了她的脸上。

examples.en: Improving public transport is one strand of a broader strategy to reduce urban air pollution.
examples.zh: 改善公共交通是减少城市空气污染这一整体策略的一个方面。

collocations: a strand of hair｜一缕头发
a strand of an argument｜论证的一个方面

senses.en: a sports contest between two people or teams
to go well together, correspond, or equal something
a small stick that produces fire when rubbed

examples.en: We watched a football match at the local park.
examples.zh: 我们在附近的公园看了一场足球比赛。

examples.en: Training programmes should match the skills taught in colleges with the needs of local employers.
examples.zh: 培训项目应使院校教授的技能与当地雇主的需求相匹配。

collocations: match A with B｜将A与B匹配

senses.en: a piece of wax with a central string that burns

examples.en: He lit a candle when the electricity went off.
examples.zh: 停电时，他点了一支蜡烛。

examples.en: Although candles create a pleasant atmosphere, they should never be left burning unattended in homes or public spaces.
examples.zh: 虽然蜡烛能营造宜人的氛围，但在住宅或公共场所，绝不能让其在无人看管时燃烧。

collocations: blow out a candle｜吹灭蜡烛

senses.en: A substance that melts easily, used for candles and protective coatings.
To cover or polish something with wax.
For the moon's visible lit surface to gradually increase.

examples.en: Warm wax dripped from the candle onto the table.
examples.zh: 温热的蜡从蜡烛上滴到了桌子上。

examples.en: A thin layer of wax can protect fresh fruit and reduce moisture loss during transport.
examples.zh: 一层薄蜡可以保护新鲜水果，并减少运输过程中的水分流失。

senses.en: a collection of work showing someone's skills and experience
a collection of investments owned by a person or organization
a minister's position or area of government responsibility

examples.en: She brought her photography portfolio to the interview.
examples.zh: 她带着自己的摄影作品集去参加面试。

examples.en: A diversified investment portfolio can reduce financial risk, although it cannot guarantee steady returns.
examples.zh: 多元化的投资组合可以降低金融风险，但不能保证稳定的回报。

collocations: a portfolio of work｜一套作品集
hold a portfolio｜担任部长职务

senses.en: A thin booklet giving information or arguments about a subject

examples.en: The nurse handed me a pamphlet about healthy eating.
examples.zh: 护士递给我一本关于健康饮食的小册子。

examples.en: Public health pamphlets should use clear language and illustrations to explain preventive measures to a broad audience.
examples.zh: 公共卫生宣传册应使用清晰的语言和插图，向广大受众解释预防措施。

collocations: a pamphlet on health｜健康宣传册

senses.en: A small piece of soft paper used for wiping.
A group of similar cells performing a particular bodily function.

examples.en: She handed me a tissue when I sneezed.
examples.zh: 我打喷嚏时，她递给我一张纸巾。

examples.en: Scientists are developing new treatments that help damaged tissue recover more effectively after an injury.
examples.zh: 科学家正在开发新疗法，帮助受损组织在受伤后更有效地修复。

collocations: a box of tissues｜一盒纸巾

senses.en: To put something over a surface or object.
To include something, deal with it, or pay its cost.
An outer layer that protects or encloses something.

examples.en: Cover the bread with a cloth while it cools.
examples.zh: 面包冷却时，用一块布盖住它。

examples.en: University scholarships should cover living expenses as well as tuition fees for students from low-income families.
examples.zh: 大学奖学金应为低收入家庭的学生支付生活费和学费。

collocations: cover a topic｜涉及某个话题

senses.en: An exact copy of something
To make an exact copy or repeat something unnecessarily
Exactly matching another item

examples.en: I keep a duplicate of the key at home.
examples.zh: 我在家里留了一把备用钥匙。

examples.en: Research teams should share their findings to avoid duplicating work and wasting limited public funding.
examples.zh: 研究团队应共享研究成果，以免重复劳动并浪费有限的公共资金。

senses.en: A written message sharing information within an organisation
A formal document recording an agreement or shared intentions

examples.en: The manager sent a memorandum about our new working hours.
examples.zh: 经理发了一份关于新工作时间的内部通知。

examples.en: The two universities signed a memorandum of understanding to support joint research into renewable energy.
examples.zh: 两所大学签署了谅解备忘录，以支持可再生能源领域的联合研究。

senses.en: Materials used for writing, such as paper, pens, and envelopes.

examples.en: I bought some stationery for my new evening class.
examples.zh: 我为新报的夜校课程买了些文具。

examples.en: Providing basic stationery can help disadvantaged students participate more fully in classroom activities and complete assignments.
examples.zh: 提供基本文具可以帮助弱势学生更充分地参与课堂活动并完成作业。

senses.en: a sticky substance used to join things together
to join things together using glue

examples.en: Use a little glue to fix the paper wing.
examples.zh: 用一点胶水把纸翅膀粘好。

examples.en: Some packaging contains layers joined with glue, which can make the materials more difficult to recycle.
examples.zh: 有些包装的各层材料用胶粘合，这可能增加回收难度。

collocations: be glued to a screen｜盯着屏幕看

senses.en: coloured liquid used for writing, drawing or printing
to apply ink to a surface

examples.en: Blue ink leaked from my pen onto my sleeve.
examples.zh: 蓝色墨水从钢笔里漏出来，沾到了我的袖子上。

examples.en: Schools can reduce their environmental impact by using less paper and choosing refillable ink cartridges.
examples.zh: 学校可以通过减少纸张用量和选择可填充墨盒来降低对环境的影响。

collocations: run out of ink｜墨水用完

senses.en: an elastic material used to make tyres and other products
a small object used to remove pencil marks

examples.en: These rubber boots keep my feet dry in puddles.
examples.zh: 这双橡胶靴让我踩水坑时双脚也不会湿。

examples.en: Recycling rubber from used tyres can reduce waste and provide material for safer playground surfaces.
examples.zh: 回收废旧轮胎中的橡胶可以减少废物，并为更安全的游乐场地面提供材料。

senses.en: A tool with two blades for cutting things.

examples.en: Please use these scissors to cut the wrapping paper.
examples.zh: 请用这把剪刀裁剪包装纸。

examples.en: Teachers should supervise young children when they use scissors during classroom craft activities.
examples.zh: 幼儿在课堂手工活动中使用剪刀时，教师应在旁监督。

collocations: a pair of scissors｜一把剪刀

senses.en: The outer limit of an object, area, or surface.
A quality that makes someone or something more competitive.
To move slowly and carefully in a particular direction.

examples.en: Keep your glass away from the edge of the table.
examples.zh: 别把你的玻璃杯放在桌子边缘。

examples.en: Practical experience can give graduates an edge over other candidates in a competitive job market.
examples.zh: 在竞争激烈的就业市场中，实践经验能让毕业生比其他求职者更有优势。

collocations: have an edge over｜比……有优势

senses.en: An important or basic part of something.
A substance that cannot be chemically divided into simpler substances.
Strong wind, rain, or other difficult weather conditions.

examples.en: Fresh herbs are a key element of this soup.
examples.zh: 新鲜香草是这道汤的关键配料。

examples.en: Public trust is an essential element of any successful policy aimed at improving community health.
examples.zh: 公众信任是任何旨在改善社区健康的政策取得成功的必要因素。

collocations: exposure to the elements｜暴露于风雨之中

senses.en: something that influences a result or situation
